insert into ManuallyVerifiedRequirements (
                    collect_nr,
                    product_id,
                    review_name,
                    review_date,
                    req_collect_nr,
                    req_id,
                    comment_hash
                )
                select
                    $1,
                    $2,
                    $3,
                    $4,
                    r.collect_nr,
                    $5,
                    $6
                from Requirements r
                where r.collect_nr = (
                    select max(cr.collect_nr)
                    from Requirements cr
                    where cr.product_id = r.product_id
                )
                and r.product_id = $2
                and r.id = $5
